ukm:Metadata.dc:title: Children Act 1989
ukm:Metadata.dc:description: An Act to reform the law relating to children; to provide for local authority services for children in need and others; to amend the law with respect to children’s homes, community homes, voluntary homes and voluntary organisations; to make provision with respect to fostering, child minding and day care for young children and adoption; and for connected purposes.

Title.Addition: Child Minding and Day Care for Children in

P1group.Title: Regulations etc. governing child minders and day care providers.

P2para.Text: The Assembly may make regulations governing the activities of registered persons who act as child minders, or provide day care, on premises in Wales.
The regulations under this section may deal with the following matters (among others)—

P3para.Text: the welfare and development of the children concerned;
suitability to look after, or be in regular contact with, children under the age of eight;
the maximum number of children who may be looked after and the number of persons required to assist in looking after them;
the maintenance, safety and suitability of premises and equipment;

P2para.Text: If the regulations require any person (other than the Assembly ) to have regard to or meet factors, standards and other matters prescribed by or referred to in the regulations, they may also provide for any allegation that the person has failed to do so to be taken into account—

P3para.Text: by the Assembly in the exercise of its functions under this Part, or
in any proceedings under this Part.
that a registered person who without reasonable excuse contravenes, or otherwise fails to comply with, any requirement of the regulations shall be guilty of an offence; and
that a person guilty of the offence shall be liable on summary conviction to a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.
